tools.name: acad_list_instances
tools.description: List explicitly paired local AutoCAD instances. No active-tab fallback.

tools.name: acad_get_status
tools.description: Read bridge/backend status; simulated backends are identified explicitly.

tools.name: acad_get_capabilities
tools.description: Read actual operations supported by the paired plugin.

tools.name: acad_list_documents
tools.description: List open drawings and their explicit identity, revision and units.

tools.name: acad_get_document_info
tools.description: Read drawing metadata without changing the current drawing.

tools.name: acad_list_layers
tools.description: Read up to 1000 layer records with names, colors, lineweights and lock state.

tools.name: acad_list_styles
tools.description: Read bounded native text/dimension style and linetype metadata.

tools.name: acad_get_plot_devices
tools.description: Read installed allowlisted PDF plot devices and canonical media names. No physical printer or arbitrary PC3 path is accepted.

tools.name: acad_list_layouts
tools.description: Read bounded layout names, paper settings and paper/model viewport geometry. Paper dimensions are millimetres; model viewport coordinates use drawing units.

tools.name: acad_create_layout
tools.description: Create a new PDF-configured paper layout with one locked model viewport. Paper center/size are millimetres; modelCenter uses lengthUnit; scale is paper-mm/model-mm (1 means 1:1). Direction is explicit. Existing layouts and model geometry are preserved.

tools.name: acad_export_pdf
tools.description: Plot one explicit existing paper layout to a NEW flat PDF filename in the private authorized output root. Physical printers and overwrite are forbidden. The active layout is restored. PDF generation is a separate filesystem side effect; reconcile operation status after timeout.

tools.name: acad_list_xrefs
tools.description: Read bounded xref names, overlay/unloaded state and basename only. Does not resolve or reload external files.

tools.name: acad_attach_xref
tools.description: Attach/overlay one DWG already staged in the private session-input root. No arbitrary paths, URLs, nested xrefs, image/underlay/datalink dependencies or custom entities are accepted in this initial importer. Place one explicit modelspace reference with uniform scale and Z rotation. Source file is read only.

tools.name: acad_manage_xref
tools.description: Reload, unload, bind or detach one named top-level xref. targets must enumerate ALL direct modelspace references; hidden/nested/paperspace references are rejected. Reload/bind accepts only a validated DWG in session-input. Detach erases those explicit references. Xref files are never deleted or modified.

tools.name: acad_run_batch
tools.description: Run up to 24 typed create_line/create_circle/create_box/create_polyline steps in one atomic transaction with one operationId and one final revision. All steps share explicit WCS/units and must be separately granted. Any failing step rolls back the entire batch. No raw commands, LISP, shell, external files or nested batches.

items.description: Fields depend on the discriminator; include only fields of the selected variant. The original strict per-variant schema is enforced at execution. tool=acad_create_line: require start, end; tool=acad_create_circle: require center, radius; tool=acad_create_box: require center, size; tool=acad_create_polyline: require vertices, closed

tools.name: acad_get_view
tools.description: Read the current modelspace camera target, direction, height, width and view-center offset in explicit units. Paper layouts are excluded.

tools.name: acad_set_view
tools.description: Set the explicit modelspace camera center, top/front/right/isometric direction and visible height. Width follows the current viewport aspect ratio. Coordinates/height use lengthUnit. Drawing entities are preserved; native camera values are reread.

tools.name: acad_create_style
tools.description: Create a new text, dimension or simple dash-pattern linetype style; no font paths or external LIN files. Font choices are installed arial.ttf and bundled txt.shx. Existing names are rejected. Dimension/linetype sizes require explicit units.

inputSchema.description: Fields depend on the discriminator; include only fields of the selected variant. The original strict per-variant schema is enforced at execution. kind=text: require font; kind=dimension: require coordinateSystem, lengthUnit, textStyle, textHeight, arrowSize, precision; kind=linetype: require coordinateSystem, lengthUnit, dashes

tools.name: acad_get_block
tools.description: Read a named local non-layout/non-xref/non-anonymous block definition and attribute defaults in explicit units. Bounded to 132 definition objects.

tools.name: acad_define_block
tools.description: Define a new block from up to 100 explicitly referenced planar curves/TEXT/MTEXT; originals are preserved. basePoint becomes the block origin. Up to 32 plain attribute definitions use block-local positions. No nested blocks or measurement dimensions in this initial definition tool.

tools.name: acad_insert_block
tools.description: Insert an existing local block with uniform positive scale and Z rotation; explicitly set known plain attribute values. Placement uses lengthUnit; attributes follow the block transform.

tools.name: acad_set_attributes
tools.description: Update only explicitly named non-constant plain attributes of one modelspace block reference. Unknown tags and locked layers are rejected atomically.

tools.name: acad_create_layer
tools.description: Create one new unlocked continuous-line layer with explicit ACI color and lineweight in hundredths of a millimetre. Existing names are rejected.

tools.name: acad_create_text
tools.description: Create plain single-line native TEXT in WCS XY; rotation is radians. Field expressions are rejected.

tools.name: acad_create_mtext
tools.description: Create plain multiline native MTEXT in WCS XY with explicit width; formatting is escaped. Rotation is radians.

tools.name: acad_create_dimension
tools.description: Create a non-associative native DIMENSION from explicit points: linear/aligned, diameter (opposite chord endpoints), radius (start=center, end=chord), angular (two lines start/end and start2/end2, linePoint on the arc), angular3 (center and two points), arc_length (center and two points on one circle) or ordinate (feature point, leader end, axis x/y from origin). Coordinates and text/arrow size use lengthUnit, rotation radians; angles are measured in radians and displayed in degrees. The measured value is never overridden: optional notation only adds ISO symbols around it (count n×, Ø/R/SØ/SR/square/t= prefix, theoretically exact frame, reference parentheses, not-to-scale underline, ISO 286 fit class with optional written deviations such as "+0,021"/"0", limit dimension from tolerance, min/max single limit, ISO 14405 size modifiers, half dimension). Tolerance lower<=0, upper>=0 are explicit deviations. Displayed decimals equal precision (tolerancePrecision for deviations), with trailing zeros kept. Display precision does not determine a tolerance: obtain it from the dimension, applicable title-block notes or a referenced standard; use decimal-place mappings only when explicitly specified. Definition points do not follow later geometry edits.

inputSchema.description: Fields depend on the discriminator; include only fields of the selected variant. The original strict per-variant schema is enforced at execution. kind=linear: require linePoint; kind=aligned: require linePoint; kind=diameter: require linePoint; kind=radius: require linePoint; kind=angular: require start2, end2, linePoint; kind=angular3: require center, linePoint; kind=arc_length: require center, linePoint; kind=ordinate: require axis

tools.name: acad_query_entities
tools.description: Read bounded modelspace entity projections with a revision-bound cursor.

tools.name: acad_get_entity
tools.description: Read one entity from its explicit drawing and epoch.

tools.name: acad_create_line
tools.description: Create a modelspace WCS line with explicit length units and read it back.

tools.name: acad_create_circle
tools.description: Create a modelspace WCS XY circle with explicit units and verify its radius.

tools.name: acad_create_arc
tools.description: Create a counterclockwise WCS XY ARC from center/radius and start/end angles in radians. Empty/full-circle arcs are rejected.

tools.name: acad_create_polyline
tools.description: Create an open or closed straight-segment native LWPOLYLINE in WCS XY; closing segment is implicit. Up to 512 vertices, no duplicate adjacent vertices.

tools.name: acad_create_box
tools.description: Create an axis-aligned modelspace solid box and read back volume and extents.

tools.name: acad_extrude
tools.description: Extrude one closed WCS XY CIRCLE/LWPOLYLINE profile along Z, without taper. Height uses lengthUnit and may be negative. Preserve the profile by default; explicitly keepProfile=false erases it atomically with creation.

tools.name: acad_revolve
tools.description: Revolve one closed WCS XY CIRCLE/LWPOLYLINE around an explicit in-plane axis. Angle is positive radians, at most 2*pi. Preserve the profile by default. Self-intersecting or invalid profiles are rejected by the native modeler.

tools.name: acad_boolean
tools.description: Union, subtract or intersect one explicit modelspace 3DSOLID with up to 16 distinct solid tools. Compute on detached copies, then atomically erase the target and create a NEW solid with a NEW entityRef. Tool entities are preserved unless keepTools=false. Empty or failed results have no drawing effect.

tools.name: acad_get_mass_properties
tools.description: Read native solid volume, surface area, centroid and bounds with explicit length/area/volume units. Mass in kg is returned only with user-supplied densityKgM3 and known drawing units; no material density is inferred.

tools.name: acad_section_solid
tools.description: Intersect one solid with an explicit WCS plane and create a native planar REGION, preserving the source. origin uses lengthUnit; normal is a unitless nonzero direction. Empty sections are rejected.

tools.name: acad_create_hatch
tools.description: Create a non-associative native SOLID or ANSI31 hatch from one outer closed XY CIRCLE/LWPOLYLINE and up to 32 inner loops. Targets are ordered outer first, then holes. Sources are preserved. Angle uses radians; ANSI31 scale multiplies the pattern base unit in lengthUnit.

tools.name: acad_create_table
tools.description: Create a plain native modelspace TABLE with explicit rectangular cells, column widths, row/text height and top-left WCS XY position. No fields or formulas; at most 100 rows by 10 columns.

tools.name: acad_get_bom
tools.description: Read selected modelspace INSERT attributes and group identical block names and explicit attribute keys with quantities. Missing keys fail explicitly; nested contents are not expanded. Read only, no inferred material or standard part data.

tools.name: acad_drill_holes
tools.description: Cut up to 64 explicit cylindrical holes along +Z or -Z in one solid, with optional explicit counterbore or conical countersink entry. Centers are entry-plane WCS points. Every hole must remove material; failure preserves all source geometry. Returns a new solid entityRef and measured removed volume. No thread geometry or inferred fastener standards.

entry.description: Fields depend on the discriminator; include only fields of the selected variant. The original strict per-variant schema is enforced at execution. kind=plain: require no additional required fields; kind=counterbore: require diameter, depth; kind=countersink: require diameter, depth

tools.name: acad_create_shaft
tools.description: Create one stepped coaxial solid along +Z from an explicit base and up to 32 length/diameter segments. No inferred standard sizes; no persistent parametric constraints.

tools.name: acad_create_feature_control_frame
tools.description: Create one native FCF geometric tolerance frame with an explicit characteristic, tolerance, optional diameter/material condition and up to three datum labels. Dimensions use lengthUnit. This encodes the chosen annotation; it does not validate the engineering choice or certify ISO compliance.

tools.name: acad_move_entities
tools.description: Translate explicitly referenced native entities and verify resulting geometry.

tools.name: acad_transform_entities
tools.description: Copy, rotate, uniformly scale, mirror, or make linear/circular arrays of WCS XY LINE/CIRCLE/ARC/LWPOLYLINE entities. Angles are radians; count includes the original; at most 100 created copies. Dimensions/text/solids are intentionally excluded. Entity geometry is reread after one transaction.

inputSchema.description: Fields depend on the discriminator; include only fields of the selected variant. The original strict per-variant schema is enforced at execution. mode=copy: require delta; mode=rotate: require center, angle; mode=scale: require center, factor; mode=mirror: require lineStart, lineEnd; mode=linear_array: require count, step; mode=circular_array: require count, center, angleStep

tools.name: acad_offset_entity
tools.description: Offset a WCS XY LINE/CIRCLE/ARC/LWPOLYLINE a positive distance toward sidePoint; source is preserved. Ambiguous or impossible offsets are rejected; result curves are verified.

tools.name: acad_edit_curve
tools.description: Trim a planar curve against explicit boundaries and retain the segment nearest keepPoint, replacing the source atomically; or extend only a LINE start/end to the nearest forward boundary intersection. Boundaries are never changed.

inputSchema.description: Fields depend on the discriminator; include only fields of the selected variant. The original strict per-variant schema is enforced at execution. mode=trim: require keepPoint; mode=extend: require end

tools.name: acad_corner
tools.description: Fillet or chamfer exactly two WCS XY LINE segments sharing one endpoint; no implicit extension. Radius or both distances must fit inside segments. Optionally trim original endpoints in the same transaction.

inputSchema.description: Fields depend on the discriminator; include only fields of the selected variant. The original strict per-variant schema is enforced at execution. kind=fillet: require radius; kind=chamfer: require distanceA, distanceB

tools.name: acad_erase_entities
tools.description: Erase explicit modelspace entities in one transaction.

tools.name: acad_setup_drawing_standard
tools.description: Create an ISO drawing profile in one transaction: ISO 3098 lettering style (isocp.shx), ISO 128-2 thin dashed/long-dash dotted/long-dash double-dotted linetypes for the chosen line group, ten prefixed layers (visible, thin, hidden, center, cutting plane, phantom, dimension, hatch, text, symbol) with thick/thin/lettering lineweights, an ISO dimension style and PSLTSCALE=1. lineGroup is the thick width in mm (thin is half); textHeight is paper mm; viewScale is paper-mm/model-mm (1 means 1:1). precision is the style default; trailing zeros are always kept because written decimals state the required precision. Existing names are rejected, nothing is overwritten. The result lists the basis of every numeric choice and reports verification pending the full ISO text.

tools.name: acad_create_leader
tools.description: Create one native MLEADER: straight leader through explicit WCS XY vertices (first = terminator point on the feature, last = start of the reference line), ISO terminator arrow/dot/none with explicit size, optional horizontal reference line (landingLength 0 disables it) and none/plain text/local block content. Text placement above sits on the reference line; after continues it. Block content connects at its base point at the end of the reference line; only existing non-constant attribute tags can be set. Vertices, terminator, landing and content are read back.

content.description: Fields depend on the discriminator; include only fields of the selected variant. The original strict per-variant schema is enforced at execution. kind=none: require no additional required fields; kind=text: require text, height, placement; kind=block: require name

tools.name: acad_create_dimension_series
tools.description: Create a chain (consecutive) or baseline (common origin) series of measured linear dimensions in one transaction. points are the explicit feature points in order; linePoint places the first dimension line; baseline lines step by spacing away from the points. Every member is read back like acad_create_dimension.

tools.name: acad_create_hole_callout
tools.description: Create an ISO 15786-style simplified hole indication as a native MLEADER: count n×, Ø diameter with optional ISO 286 hole class, ×depth, counterbore (⌴Ø×depth) or countersink (⌵Ø×angle), or metric thread designation with ×depth and optional tap drill. Sizes are written decimal strings ("6,6", "11,00") reproduced exactly, including trailing zeros; only the separator follows decimalSeparator. Written decimal places do not by themselves define a tolerance; use the dimension, applicable title-block notes or a referenced standard. Values come only from the request; pass circle to check the noted diameter against a real CIRCLE. Callout layout is pending full-text verification.

tools.name: acad_get_operation_status
tools.description: Reconcile an operation after timeout. Missing records do not prove no effect.

tools.name: acad_save_copy
tools.description: Write a new authorized DWG copy without replacing existing files or renaming the source.
